summary: This note covers the seventh series of the British reality TV show Ex on the Beach, which premiered on 20 June 2017 and was filmed on location in Bali, Indonesia. The series was confirmed on 26 February 2017, and its cast was announced on 23 May 2017. The lineup includes personalities from other British reality shows, and two of the cast had appeared in earlier series of the show.
one_line: Seventh series of the British reality show Ex on the Beach, premiering June 2017 and filmed in Bali, Indonesia.
key_facts: The seventh series of Ex on the Beach began on 20 June 2017.
The seventh series was filmed on location on the island of Bali in Indonesia.
The seventh series was confirmed on 26 February 2017.
The cast members for the seventh series were confirmed on 23 May 2017.
Chloe Ferry and Marty McKenna were cast as Geordie Shore stars in the seventh series of Ex on the Beach.
Max Morley and Josh Ritchie were cast in the seventh series as Love Island contestants.
Savannah Kemplay was cast in the seventh series as a Beauty School Cop Outs cast member.
Marty McKenna had previously appeared in the third series of Ex on the Beach.
Josh Ritchie had previously appeared in the sixth series of Ex on the Beach.
